#### Load data
```{r load-rds, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
mg <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/mg.rds"))
mg_rar <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/mg_rar.rds"))
metadata <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/metadata_final.rds"))
count_summary <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/count_summary.rds"))
pcadf <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/pcadf_clim.rds"))
pca_litt_df_md <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/pca_litt_df_md.rds"))
mg_subclades <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/mg_subclades.rds"))
mg_clades <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/mg_clades.rds"))
clim_vars_PC <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/clim_vars_PC.rds"))
litter_vars <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/litter_vars.rds"))
pcadf_expanded  <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/pcadf_expanded.rds"))
curto_nmds_df   <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/curto_nmds_df.rds"))
clds_nmds_df       <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/clds_nmds_df.rds"))
subclds_nmds_df    <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/subclds_nmds_df.rds"))
mg_distmat         <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/mg_distmat.rds"))
mg_clds_distmat             <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/mg_clds_distmat.rds"))
mg_subclds_distmat          <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/mg_subclds_distmat.rds"))
curto_clades_unrar_otutab   <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/curto_clades_unrar_otutab.rds"))
curto_subclades_unrar_otutab <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/curto_subclades_unrar_otutab.rds"))
tax                  <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/tax.rds"))
clade_colors         <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/clade_colors.rds"))
subclade_colros      <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/subclade_colros.rds"))
color_mapping_vector <- readRDS(here::here("results/rds/color_mapping_vector.rds"))
```

##### dbRDAs

```{r dbRDA, fig.width=30, fig.height=25, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hold', echo=FALSE}
#preparing data for dbRDA analysis

#metadata for analysis and plots
md4dbrda <- curto_nmds_df %>% column_to_rownames("Row.names") %>% 
  dplyr::select(3:41, reserve_litter)

#transform coordinates into a range from 0-1
geog.stand <- md4dbrda %>%
  dplyr::select(c(plot_cordsX, plot_cordsY, Elevation)) %>%
  decostand("range")


#adding transformed coordinates to metadata
md4dbrda <- md4dbrda %>%  
  dplyr::select(-c(plot_cordsX, plot_cordsY, Elevation)) %>%
  merge(., pcadf_expanded |> dplyr::select(-SiteID),
        by.x = "row.names", by.y = "SampleID") %>%
  dplyr::rename(PC1.clim = PC1,
                PC2.clim = PC2) %>%
  merge(., pca_litt_df_md %>%
          dplyr::select(Row.names, PC1, PC2),
        by = "Row.names") %>%
  dplyr::rename(PC1.litt = PC1,
                PC2.litt = PC2)
  

# dbRDA with variable reduction by correlation
curto_dbRDA <- dbrda(mg_distmat ~ MAT + T.Iso + T.DryQ + T.MinColdMo + MAP + P.Seas + T.Diurn + P.WarmQ + P.DryMo + pH + crude_protein + cellulose + hemicellulose + lignin,
                     data = md4dbrda, na.action = na.exclude, distance = "bray")

print(curto_dbRDA)

curto_dbRDA_summary <- summary(curto_dbRDA)
k <- curto_dbRDA$CCA$rank


scores(curto_dbRDA, display = "sites", choices = 1:15, scaling = 2)
scores(curto_dbRDA, display = "sites",
                              choices = (k + 1):(k + 2), scaling = 2)


anova(curto_dbRDA, permutations = 999)
# Run Anova
dbrada_curto_anova_terms <- anova(curto_dbRDA, by = "terms", permutations = 999)
# Extract SS for terms
dbrada_curto_sum_of_sqs_trms <- dbrada_curto_anova_terms$`SumOfSqs`[1:(nrow(dbrada_curto_anova_terms) - 1)]

# Extract total and constrained variance
dbrada_curto_total_variance <- sum(curto_dbRDA$tot.chi)
dbrada_curto_constrained_variance <- sum(curto_dbRDA$CCA$eig)


# Calculate proportions
dbrda_curto_constrained_proportions <- (dbrada_curto_sum_of_sqs_trms / dbrada_curto_constrained_variance) * 100
dbrda_curto_total_proportions <- (dbrada_curto_sum_of_sqs_trms / dbrada_curto_total_variance) * 100

dbrda_curto_contributions_results <- data.frame(
    Term = rownames(dbrada_curto_anova_terms)[1:(nrow(dbrada_curto_anova_terms) - 1)],
    SumOfSqs = dbrada_curto_sum_of_sqs_trms,
    Constrained_Proportion = dbrda_curto_constrained_proportions,
    Total_Proportion = dbrda_curto_total_proportions,
    tax_level = "Strain",
    P_val = dbrada_curto_anova_terms$`Pr(>F)`[1:(nrow(dbrada_curto_anova_terms) - 1)]
)


dbrda_curto_contributions_results <- dbrda_curto_contributions_results |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(3,4), names_to = "Proportion", values_to = "Percent") |>
  mutate(Term = gsub("_", " ", Term)) |> 
  mutate(Term = gsub("\\.", "_", Term)
         ) |>
  mutate(Term = factor(Term, levels = c("MAT",
                                        "T_Iso",
                                        "T_DryQ",
                                        "T_MinColdMo",
                                        "MAP",
                                        "P_Seas",
                                        "T_Diurn",
                                        "P_WarmQ",
                                        "P_DryMo",
                                        "pH",
                                        "crude protein",
                                        "cellulose",
                                        "hemicellulose",
                                        "lignin")))


dbrda_curto_contributions_plot <- dbrda_curto_contributions_results |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Proportion, y = Percent, fill = Term)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = allvars_pallete) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Constrained", "Total")) +
    labs(y = "% of variance contrubition") +
    apatheme +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
          text = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),  # Make legend keys smaller
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  # Reduce text size for legend items
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),  # Adjust legend title size
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),  # Reduce vertical spacing between legend items
    legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(2, 2, 2, 2))
dbrda_curto_contributions_plot




#getting points to plot with ggplot
curto_dbRDA_plot_df <- cbind(scores(curto_dbRDA, display = "sites", choices = 15:16, scaling = 2), md4dbrda)

# get points to plot vectors (variables loadings)

curto_dbRDA$CCA$

curto_dbRDA$CCA$biplot


dbRDA_loadings <- data.frame(Variables = rownames(curto_dbRDA$CCA$biplot), curto_dbRDA$CCA$biplot)

#ggplot
dbRDA_plot<-ggplot(curto_dbRDA_plot_df
                 , aes(MDS1, MDS2)) +
  geom_point(data = curto_dbRDA_plot_df, aes(color = Ecosystem, shape = Litter_type),  size = 5, alpha = 0.75) +
  #geom_text(data = curto_dbRDA_plot_df, aes(x=dbRDA1, y=dbRDA2-0.025, label=row.names(curto_dbRDA_plot_df)), size=4.75) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ecosystem_colors, name="Ecosystem") +
  geom_segment(data = dbRDA_loadings,
               aes(x=0,xend=dbRDA1,y=0,yend=dbRDA2),
               #arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm")),
               colour="grey", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
 geom_label(data=dbRDA_loadings,
           aes(x=dbRDA1*1.1, y=dbRDA2*1.1, label=gsub("\\.", " ", Variables)),
           size=5,
           colour = "darkblue",
           #fill = "white", # Optional: Background fill color for the label
           alpha = 0.75,
          label.padding = unit(0.2, "lines"), # Padding around the text
          label.size = 0.25) +
  #ggtitle("dbRDA, Rar. depth: 1000. Reduction of variables by correlation") +
 #annotate("text", x = -7.5 , y = -6, label = "Stress = 0.1", size = 3.5) +
 #annotate("text", x = -7.5, y = -6.5, label = "[PERMANOVA ~ Site: F = 3.28, P < 0.001]", size = 3.5) +
  xlab("dbRDA1 (13.12% total, 36.94% constrained)") +
  ylab("dbRDA2 (5.47% total, 15.41% constrained)") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title.position = "top"),
         shape = guide_legend(title.position = "top", title = "Litter type")) +
  apatheme +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "bottom")
dbRDA_plot



ggarrange(dbRDA_plot, dbrda_curto_contributions_plot,
          nrow = 1,
          widths = c(1, 0.5),
          labels = "AUTO")


width <- 320

ggsave(here::here("plots/dBRDA/curto_dbrda_prop_plot.png"),
       width = width,
       height = width*0.65,
       units = "mm",
       dpi = 300)
```

```{r dbrda-clade, fig.width=25, fig.height=20, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hold', echo=FALSE}
#### clades ####

#preparing data for dbRDA analysis
#metadata for analysis and plots
md4dbrda_clades <- clds_nmds_df %>% column_to_rownames("Row.names") %>% 
  dplyr::select(3:41)

 
# dbRDA with variable reduction by correlation
clades_dbRDA <- dbrda(mg_clds_distmat ~  MAT +
                        `T Iso` +
                        `T DryQ` +
                        `T MinColdMo` +
                        MAP +
                        `P Seas` +
                        `T Diurn` +
                        `P WarmQ` +
                        `P DryMo` +
                        pH + crude_protein + cellulose + hemicellulose + lignin,
                     data = md4dbrda_clades, distance = "bray", na.action = na.exclude)



print(clades_dbRDA)

clades_dbRDA_summary <- summary(clades_dbRDA)
clades_dbRDA_summary

anova(clades_dbRDA, permutations = 999)
# Run Anova
dbrada_clades_anova_terms <- anova(clades_dbRDA, by = "terms", permutations = 999)
# Extract SS for terms
dbrada_clades_sum_of_sqs_trms <- dbrada_clades_anova_terms$`SumOfSqs`[1:(nrow(dbrada_clades_anova_terms) - 1)]

# Extract total and constrained variance
dbrada_clades_total_variance <- sum(clades_dbRDA$tot.chi)
dbrada_clades_constrained_variance <- sum(clades_dbRDA$CCA$eig)


# Calculate proportions
dbrda_clades_constrained_proportions <- (dbrada_clades_sum_of_sqs_trms / dbrada_clades_constrained_variance) * 100
dbrda_clades_total_proportions <- (dbrada_clades_sum_of_sqs_trms / dbrada_clades_total_variance) * 100

dbrda_clades_contributions_results <- data.frame(
    Term = rownames(dbrada_clades_anova_terms)[1:(nrow(dbrada_clades_anova_terms) - 1)],
    SumOfSqs = dbrada_clades_sum_of_sqs_trms,
    Constrained_Proportion = dbrda_clades_constrained_proportions,
    Total_Proportion = dbrda_clades_total_proportions,
    tax_level = "Clade",
    P_val = dbrada_clades_anova_terms$`Pr(>F)`[1:(nrow(dbrada_clades_anova_terms) - 1)]
)


dbrda_clades_contributions_results <- dbrda_clades_contributions_results |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(3,4), names_to = "Proportion", values_to = "Percent") |>
  mutate(Term = gsub("`", "", Term)) |>
  mutate(Term = gsub("_", " ", Term)) |>
  mutate(Term = factor(Term, levels = c("MAT",
                                                "T Iso",
                                                "T Diurn",
                                                "T DryQ",
                                                "T MinColdMo",
                                                "MAP",
                                                "P DryMo",
                                                "P WarmQ",
                                                "P Seas",
                                                "cellulose",
                                                "crude protein",
                                                "hemicellulose",
                                                "lignin",
                                                "pH")))


dbrda_clades_contributions_plot <- dbrda_clades_contributions_results |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Proportion, y = Percent, fill = Term)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = allvars_pallete3) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Constrained", "Total")) +
    labs(y = "% of variance contrubition") +
    apatheme +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
          text = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),  # Make legend keys smaller
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  # Reduce text size for legend items
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),  # Adjust legend title size
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),  # Reduce vertical spacing between legend items
    legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(2, 2, 2, 2))
dbrda_clades_contributions_plot
```

```{r r dbrda-subclade, fig.width=25, fig.height=20, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hold', echo=FALSE}
#metadata for analysis and plots

# dbRDA with variable reduction by correlation
subclades_dbRDA <- dbrda(mg_subclds_distmat ~ MAT +
                           `T Iso` +
                           `T DryQ` +
                           `T MinColdMo` +
                           MAP +
                           `P Seas` +
                           `T Diurn` +
                           `P WarmQ` +
                           `P DryMo` +
                           pH +
                           crude_protein + cellulose + hemicellulose + lignin,
                     data = md4dbrda_subclades, distance = "bray", na.action = na.exclude)

print(subclades_dbRDA)

subclades_dbRDA_summary <- summary(subclades_dbRDA)
subclades_dbRDA_summary

anova(subclades_dbRDA, permutations = 999)
# Run Anova
dbrada_subclades_anova_terms <- anova(subclades_dbRDA, by = "terms", permutations = 999)
# Extract SS for terms
dbrada_subclades_sum_of_sqs_trms <- dbrada_subclades_anova_terms$`SumOfSqs`[1:(nrow(dbrada_subclades_anova_terms) - 1)]

# Extract total and constrained variance

dbrada_subclades_constrained_variance <- sum(subclades_dbRDA$CCA$eig)


# Calculate proportions

dbrda_subclades_total_proportions <- (dbrada_subclades_sum_of_sqs_trms / dbrada_subclades_total_variance) * 100

dbrda_subclades_contributions_results <- data.frame(
    Term = rownames(dbrada_subclades_anova_terms)[1:(nrow(dbrada_subclades_anova_terms) - 1)],
    SumOfSqs = dbrada_subclades_sum_of_sqs_trms,
    Constrained_Proportion = dbrda_subclades_constrained_proportions,

)

## dbRDA subclade level with climate and litter PCs ####

subclades_dbRDA_PCA_clim_litt<- dbrda(mg_subclds_distmat ~ PC1.clim + PC2.clim + PC1.litt + PC2.litt,
                     data = md4dbrda_subclades, distance = "bray", na.action = na.exclude)

print(subclades_dbRDA_PCA_clim_litt)

subclades_dbRDA_summary_PCA_clim_litt <- summary(subclades_dbRDA_PCA_clim_litt)
subclades_dbRDA_summary_PCA_clim_litt

anova(subclades_dbRDA_PCA_clim_litt, permutations = 999)
# Run Anova
dbrada_subclades_anova_terms_PCA_clim_litt <- anova(subclades_dbRDA_PCA_clim_litt, by = "terms", permutations = 999)
# Extract SS for terms
dbrada_subclades_sum_of_sqs_trms_PCA_clim_litt <- dbrada_subclades_anova_terms_PCA_clim_litt$`SumOfSqs`[1:(nrow(dbrada_subclades_anova_terms_PCA_clim_litt) - 1)]

# Extract total and constrained variance
dbrada_subclades_total_variance_PCA_clim_litt <- sum(subclades_dbRDA_PCA_clim_litt$tot.chi)
dbrada_subclades_constrained_variance_PCA_clim_litt <- sum(subclades_dbRDA_PCA_clim_litt$CCA$eig)


# Calculate proportions
dbrda_subclades_constrained_proportions_PCA_clim_litt <- (dbrada_subclades_sum_of_sqs_trms_PCA_clim_litt / dbrada_subclades_constrained_variance_PCA_clim_litt) * 100
dbrda_subclades_total_proportions_PCA_clim_litt <- (dbrada_subclades_sum_of_sqs_trms_PCA_clim_litt / dbrada_subclades_total_variance_PCA_clim_litt) * 100

dbrda_subclades_contributions_results_PCA_clim_litt <- data.frame(
    Term = rownames(dbrada_subclades_anova_terms_PCA_clim_litt)[1:(nrow(dbrada_subclades_anova_terms_PCA_clim_litt) - 1)],
    SumOfSqs = dbrada_subclades_sum_of_sqs_trms_PCA_clim_litt,
    Constrained_Proportion = dbrda_subclades_constrained_proportions_PCA_clim_litt,
    Total_Proportion = dbrda_subclades_total_proportions_PCA_clim_litt,
    tax_level = "Subclade",
    P_val = dbrada_subclades_anova_terms_PCA_clim_litt$`Pr(>F)`[1:(nrow(dbrada_subclades_anova_terms_PCA_clim_litt) - 1)]
)


dbrda_subclades_contributions_results_PCA_clim_litt <- dbrda_subclades_contributions_results_PCA_clim_litt |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(3,4), names_to = "Proportion", values_to = "Percent") |>
  mutate(Term = gsub("\\.", " ", Term)) |>
  mutate(Term = factor(Term, levels = c("PC1 clim", "PC2 clim",
                                                "PC1 litt", "PC2 litt")))


dbrda_subclades_contributions_plot_PCA_clim_litt <- dbrda_subclades_contributions_results_PCA_clim_litt |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Proportion, y = Percent, fill = Term)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = allvars_pallete_2) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Constrained", "Total")) +
    labs(y = "% of variance contrubition") +
    apatheme +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          text = element_text(size = 22))
```

```{r dbrda-variance-contributions, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hold', echo=FALSE}
  filter(tax_level == "Subclade") |>
  mutate(Term = gsub("_", " ", Term)) |>
  mutate(Term = factor(Term, levels = c("PC1 clim",
                                        "PC2 clim",
                                        "cellulose",
                                        "crude protein",
                                        "hemicellulose",
                                        "lignin",
                                        "pH"))) |>
  # Create a new column 'sig' that is "*" if P_val < 0.05, else empty
  mutate(sig = ifelse(P_val < 0.05, "*", "")) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = tax_level, y = Percent, fill = Term, color = Term)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = allvars_pallete_2, name = "Variable") +
      scale_color_manual(values = allvars_pallete_2, name = "Variable") +
  # Add text labels with the asterisks above the bars; adjust vjust to position vertically
  geom_text(aes(label = sig),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
            vjust = -0.25,  # moves text above the bar
            size = 10,
            color = "black") +
      labs(y = "Proportion of explained variance (%)") +
    apatheme +
```

```{r distlm-variance-contributions, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hold', echo=FALSE}

DistLM_prop <- read.table(here::here("DistLM_marginal_tests.txt"), header = T, sep = "\t")

red_palette <- c("#FF6666", "#FF9999", "#FF0000", "#CC0000", "#990000")
blue_palette <- c("#66CCFF", "#3399FF", "#0066CC", "#003399")

combined_palette <- c(red_palette, blue_palette, "black")

DitsLM_prop_plot <- DistLM_prop %>% mutate(Variable = gsub("\\.", " ", Variable)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = tax_level, y = Prop., color = Variable, group = Variable)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = combined_palette, limits = c("Annual Mean Temperature",
                                                           "Isothermality",
                                                           "Mean Diurnal Range",
                                                           "Mean Temperature of Driest Quarter",
                                                           "Min Temperature of Coldest Month",
                                                           "Annual Precipitation",
                                                           "Precipitation of Driest Month",
                                                           "Precipitation of Warmest Quarter",
                                                           "Precipitation Seasonality",
                                                           "pH")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(x = "Taxonomic level", y = "Proportion of explained variance", title = "Proportion of explained variance in DistLM model") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Clade", "Subclade", "Strain")) +
  apatheme
  
print(DitsLM_prop_plot)

ggsave(here::here("plots/DistLM_explained_var.png"),
       width =  25,
       height = 20,
       units = "cm",
       dpi = 320)

```
